verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents a short install path: `npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`, then `ultrametric init` with a dry-run preview before it writes skill files for Codex and Claude Code. Hands-on probes confirm the CLI installs and that the init dry run previews both SKILL.md targets keylessly. However, nothing documents a quickstart or a time target. A real (non-dry-run) init was not recorded. Hosted process functions also require a device-code login with human approval, so a fully working skill needs an account step. Missing for 10: a documented quickstart with a time target, a recorded non-dry-run init writing the skill, and evidence the installed skill works end to end without a login step.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from nothing to a working installed skill in under five minutes

citations.quote: The first command previews changes. The second writes the selected skill files.
The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.
the dry run previews both harness targets (Codex .agents/skills and Claude Code .claude/skills) without writing anything.
